heuristics.Easy: Tier 1: Direct single-pass arrays, basic hash table lookups, elementary math / string formatting
heuristics.Easy-Medium: Tier 2: Easy with algorithmic twists (two pointers / basic DP) or short standard Mediums
heuristics.Medium: Tier 3: Core Medium questions (Tree/Graph BFS/DFS, Binary Search, Sliding Window, Greedy)
heuristics.Medium-Hard: Tier 4: Advanced Mediums (1D DP, Segment Trees, Bitmasks) or approachable Hard questions
heuristics.Hard: Tier 5: Deep multi-dimensional DP, Complex Segment Trees, Network Flows, Game Theory
